report.description: Zendesk provides a comprehensive suite of customer service APIs covering ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, sales CRM and omnichannel routing. The APIs support creating, reading, updating, and searching tickets and users, and can be accessed via OAuth, basic authentication, or API tokens.
report.main_blocker: Requires admin‑level OAuth token (global token) for multi‑tenant integrations

evidence.claim: Zendesk supports OAuth access tokens and requires a verified user for API requests
Basic authentication with email and password is also supported for API calls
Global OAuth access tokens are required for apps, integrations, or bots that serve multiple Zendesk customers
Zendesk offers a wide range of APIs across ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, sales CRM and more
OAuth 2.0 flows (Authorization Code, Resource Owner Password Credentials) are provided for authentication
